content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling digital products, such as Notion templates, for crypto involves more than just listing your items online. It requires a comprehensive infrastructure that can handle automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This infrastructure is crucial for digital creators who want to maintain control over their sales process and avoid platform fees. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, whereas NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, resulting in significant savings for creators.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind selling digital products for crypto involves several key components, including hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. Platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages can be used for hosting, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets can store orders, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 can deliver files. NOWPayments, with its support for over 300 cryptocurrencies and 0.5% fee, enables automatic on-chain crypto payment verification.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. Creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh can benefit from this solution, which provides them with the tools they need to sell their digital products globally. By using this infrastructure, creators can maintain ownership and control over their sales process, avoiding platform fees and restrictions.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks provide creators with full ownership and control over their sales process.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of this infrastructure work together seamlessly to provide a comprehensive solution for selling digital products. For example, when a customer purchases a Notion template, the payment is processed through NOWPayments, which triggers an automatic webhook that delivers the product instantly. This process is facilitated by the backend logic, which ensures that the product is delivered to the customer's email or download link. The order is then stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, providing the creator with a record of the sale.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure today, creators can start by choosing a hosting platform and setting up their store. They can then configure their backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script and connect it to their payment processor, NOWPayments. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, creators have everything they need to build, deploy, and scale their sovereign digital commerce stack. This kit provides a comprehensive guide to deploying the infrastructure, including setup instructions and troubleshooting tips.
